items.t: Patrick Stewart has died at age 86
items.x: The actor died at his home in Los Angeles following a "brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.

items.t: Mandarin vs St. Augustine: Unbeaten Yellow Jackets, familiar faces and a final regular-season home game for the Mustangs
items.x: Mandarin made quick work of Bartram Trail, winning 49-7 and setting up a marquee matchup to close the regular season: the Varsity 4 Game of the Week against undefeated St. Augustine.

items.t: Patrick Stewart, stage giant also of ‘Star Trek’ and 'X-Men' fame, dies at 86
items.x: Patrick Stewart, the classically trained stage actor who scaled the Shakespearean canon and added gravitas to a “Star Trek” franchise and the “X-Men” films, has died.

items.t: Ingoglia vs. Taddeo | Previewing the race for Florida Chief Financial Officer
items.x: Both major candidates for CFO are running as the taxpayers' watchdog. Five days before the election, they disagree sharply about whose spending needs watching.

items.t: AMC unveils popcorn bucket designs for 'Dune 3'
items.x: AMC is bringing double the sandworms for the final installment of the "Dune" trilogy. Here are the popcorn bucket designs for the upcoming movie.

items.t: How often are DUI charges reduced? I-TEAM finds nearly 3 in 10 cases lowered to reckless driving in Duval, Clay counties
items.x: A News4JAX review of five years of court records found that hundreds of people were arrested more than once for DUI. In one case, a man whose probation ended early was arrested again after a crash that killed a St. Johns County woman.

items.t: Judge blocks Trump administration's Medicaid rule forcing sick recipients to prove frailty
items.x: A federal judge has ruled that chronically ill people on Medicaid won’t be bound by new work requirement rules that the latest Trump administration guidance requires in order to qualify for “medically frail” exemptions.

items.t: Coastal Flood Warnings Continue Through Saturday Morning
items.x: Showers possible for Trick or Treating and Tailgating

items.t: Police chief says shooting outside Virginia GOP offices has nothing to do with election
items.x: Police say a shooting outside the Republican Party of Virginia offices in Richmond Thursday is unrelated to the upcoming midterm elections.

items.t: Hometown of ‘Addams Family’ creator becomes ghoulish Halloween destination
items.x: The New Jersey town that helped birth "The Addams Family" is embracing its spooky and kooky legacy with ghoulish and humorous October events.

items.t: Nearly 6 million French press coffee makers under recall over burn risk
items.x: their glass containers can break, posing a burn risk. See the models impacted.

items.t: Daily Dose: Medicare changes for 2027, spotting a stroke fast and why real pumpkin wins
items.x: Medicare open enrollment ends Dec. 7, with plan changes and higher costs coming in 2027. Plus, how to spot a stroke quickly and why real pumpkin beats pumpkin spice.

items.t: Pilot flies kitten with twisted legs to Kansas for treatment
items.x: A husband and wife used their plane to fly a 10-week-old kitten, who suffers from twisted leg syndrome, to veterinarians to try to straighten out her back legs.

items.t: 6-year-old sells candy bars during standstill traffic on Kentucky bridge
items.x: A 6-year-old boy in Kentucky took fundraising to new heights, selling chocolates to drivers stuck in traffic after a crash.

items.t: Young girls skip school with their parents to attend Valkyries' early WNBA Finals watch party
items.x: Sika Lopez took 11-year-old daughter Kendra out of school to be part of the early morning watch party outside Chase Center cheering for the Golden State Valkyries.

items.t: 375,000 space heaters recalled because they could overheat and catch fire
items.x: Hundreds of thousands of space heaters have been recalled after more than a dozen incidents where they've ignited after overheating.

items.t: Milwaukee is closing schools for the Brewers' long-awaited World Series title parade Friday
items.x: Milwaukee could come to a standstill as fans celebrate the Brewers’ first World Series title.

items.t: WATCH: Deer smashes into a woman leaving a North Carolina laundromat
items.x: A deer caused chaos at a North Carolina laundromat, leaping over a car and into a woman before crashing through a window.

items.t: Facebook to notify parents if teens 'repeatedly' search for terms related to suicide, self-harm
items.x: Facebook will alert parent for teens’ searches on Facebook for suicide or self-harm, as well as for teens’ conversations with Meta AI on Facebook and Messenger.

items.t: Make no bones about it, the giant skeleton has become an American Halloween fixture
items.x: It reared its bony head in 2020, during that first, chaotic pandemic year that was rife with grief and fear but also toilet paper hoarding and questionable lockdown-inspired purchases.
